distinguishing_from: SYNTHETIC, zero-byte body. Only the status line carries information.
notes: Pairs with mockhttpstatus_500 to show that 500 bodies range from nothing at all to a one-line string.

distinguishing_from: SYNTHETIC. 25-byte body containing only the status text, no HTML tags at all, so an HTML parser yields nothing to match on.
notes: Smallest fixture in the corpus. Useful for testing that the classifier does not crash on non-HTML bodies.

No genuine 5xx occurred across ~37 fetches to 25 hosts, which is itself a finding: real server errors are rare enough on major sites that they cannot be scheduled. Collect opportunistically from production traffic.
